context.transcript:
Why is the contractor coming in tomorrow?
A. I thought you asked him to come.
B. You have to initial every page.
C. At least three weeks.
context.transcript_translation:
承包商明天来做什么？
A. 我以为你让他来的。
B. 你必须在每页上签到。
C. 至少三周。

choices: I thought you asked him to come.

items.question: Why is the contractor coming in tomorrow?
